rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for putting things into a container or filling it.

example.english: I'll pack your clothes for you first.
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 nei5 zong1 hou2 di1 saam1 sin1

rows.note: Use this for a full deck of playing cards.

example.english: This pack of cards is missing one card—how are we supposed to play?
example.jyutping: ni1 fu3 paai4 siu2 zo2 zoeng1 dim2 waan2 aa3

rows.note: Use 包 as the all-purpose physical-package word, including a bundle or a pack of cigarettes.

example.english: There's a pack of cigarettes in my backpack.
example.traditional: 我背囊入面有一包香煙。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bui3 nong4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 baau1 hoeng1 jin1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on stuffing something completely full or crowding people or things into a space.

example.english: We pack the suitcase completely full, so nothing else will fit.
example.traditional: 我哋將個喼塞滿，乜都放唔落。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 go3 gip1 sak1 mun5 mat1 dou1 fong3 m4 lok6

rows.note: Use this for a group of animals, especially dogs or hounds living or hunting together.

example.english: There's a pack of hounds in the woods.
example.jyutping: syu6 lam4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 kwan4 lip6 hyun2

rows.note: Use this when loose material becomes compressed into a compact mass.

example.english: Before moving house, we pack the cotton down tightly.
example.traditional: 搬屋之前，我哋先將啲棉花壓實。
example.jyutping: bun1 uk1 zi1 cin4 ngo5 dei6 sin1 zoeng1 di1 min4 faa1 aat3 sat6

rows.note: Use this for a group of people acting together, especially a gang or a group of criminals.

example.english: This pack of thieves only come out at night to rob people.
example.traditional: 呢幫賊專係夜晚出嚟打劫。
example.jyutping: ni1 bong1 caak6 zyun1 hai6 je6 maan5 ceot1 lei4 daa2 gip3

rows.note: Use this when pack means applying a pack as medical treatment, such as a hot or cold pack on an arm, rather than for packing a container or sealing an engine joint.

example.english: If you sprain your wrist, pack it with an ice pack.
example.traditional: 手腕扭親，就用冰袋敷住佢。
example.jyutping: sau2 wun2 nau2 can1 zau6 jung6 bing1 doi6 fu1 zyu6 keoi5
